frequency_question: What proportion of formal agenda items regarding financial service tax classifications reach council approval within the specified short-term window once visible advance signals appear?
membership_rule: Includes all formal tax rate or service classification proposals affecting banking, NBFCs, or fintech brought before the national indirect tax council where prior consultative or committee papers were published. Excludes emergency cess changes or general budget-day omnibus amendments.

cases.name: Online gaming and casino 28% GST valuation clarification
Reversal of input tax credit on specific intermediary bank services
Co-branded credit card GST exemption review
Corporate guarantee taxability clarification between related entities

coverage_note: 5 named major financial/intermediary service tax clarity items; believed roughly 8-10 total similar specific sub-items in the period.
known_gaps: Excludes minor administrative tweaks that did not attract national financial press coverage prior to the council meeting.
skeleton: Specific regulatory/tax sub-items brought by fitment committees to the council resulting in formal notifications
multiplier: 3 hits out of 5 observed major sector-specific classification proposals proceeding to formal council ratification within the designated timeframe.
validity_reason: The procedural workflow of the council and fitment committee review cycles remains stable over multi-year horizons barring major legislative overhauls.
